test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
In the following diagram, the triangle represents the students who want to have Dosa in their lunch. The rectangle represents the students who want to have sandwich in their lunch. The circle represents the students who want to have pizza in their lunch. The square represents the students who want to have Idli in their lunch. The hexagon represents those students who want to have Puri Sabji at the time of lunch.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b78e5677eff6b270b5e93f9eab1a97645fa155871d54d02ecb5951a3cd1c495c.png] 

How many students want to have Dosa, sandwich and pizza, all three in their lunch?
solution:
According to the given information:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c00e625fc618e31768f38a34509391b45421d52fbecd09db4e1a16e2ed332d18.png] 

The shaded part represents "students want to have Dosa, sandwich and pizza, all three in their lunch".

Thus students want to have Dosa, sandwich and pizza, all three in their lunch = **25.**

Hence, the correct answer is** "25".**
